message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes based on facts.

First part: intentional injury (故意伤害) causing light injury (轻伤). So crime: 故意伤害.

Second part: non-state staff bribery (受贿) i.e., 非国家工作人员受贿. So crime: 受贿.

Thus two crimes: 故意伤害;受贿.

Check if any other crimes: maybe also "行贿"? No, he received bribes, not gave. So just those two.

Thus answer format: [罪名]故意伤害;受贿<eoa>
